name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cardText:
1
Start by lying flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
2
Hold the dumbbells at chest level with your palms facing forward.
3
Engage your core and press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.

name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Lay flat on the floor or a bench with your fists extended to the ceiling and a neutral grip.
Break at the elbows until your fists are by your temples. Then extend your elbows and flex your triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit on the bench and hold a dumbbell with both hands. Raise the dumbbell overhead at arms length, holding the weight up with the palms of your hands.
Keep your elbows in while you lower the weight behind your head, your upper arms stationary.
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Decline Skullcrusher
instructions: Start by lying on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with your arms extended and your palms facing each other. This is the starting position.
Slowly lower the dumbbells towards your forehead by bending your elbows. Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms.
Once the dumbbells are close to your forehead, reverse the motion by extending your elbows and returning to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Rolling Tricep Extension
instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead.
Flex at the elbows until the dumbbell is behind your head.
Then extend your elbows until the dumbbell is back in the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend at the waist and place your opposite hand on your knee for support.
From this starting position, extend your arm backwards so that the dumbbell is behind your body.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand tall with a single dumbbell extended overhead.
Flex at the elbow letting the dumbbell travel behind your body.
Try not to let your elbow flare outward.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells extended toward the ceiling.
Maintain an overhand grip. Flex at the elbows.
The dumbbells will land on your upper chest/clavicle.
Extend your elbows bringing the dumbbells back into their starting position.
*Named after Dave Tate*

name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Press
cardText:
1
Start in a bench press position with two dumbbells.
2
Break at one of your elbows first while keeping the other elbow extended.
3
Your working arm should reach your side before pressing back to the ceiling.
4
Then alternate to the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Decline Alternating Single Arm Press
cardText:
1
Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
2
Break at one of your arms first bringing that arm to your side while keeping the other arm extended.
3
Press the dumbbell back to the ceiling. Fully extend that arm before initiating on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
2
Break at the elbows and bring your upper arms to your side.
3
Once your upper arms have reached your side, press the dumbbells back to the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Decline Guillotine Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
3
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
3
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
4
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Bench Press
cardText:
1
Start by laying on a decline bench with two dumbbells.
2
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
3
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
4
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
5
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.

name: Dumbbell Decline Squeeze Press
cardText:
1
Lay flat on a decline bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
2
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
3
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
4
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Guillotine Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on the flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
3
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on the incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
3
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Neutral Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on a flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
3
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
4
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on an incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
3
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
4
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Seated Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench , grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your shoulder joint, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Seated Arnold Press
instructions: Begin seated on an upright bench with your palms facing you.
Begin pressing toward the ceiling. As you press, rotate your palms.
As you extend your elbows fully your palms should be facing forward.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
cardText:
1
Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
2
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
3
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
4
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Press
cardText:
1
Start by laying on a bench with two dumbbells.
2
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
3
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
4
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
5
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press
instructions: Start in a standing position

name: Dumbbell Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Start with two dumbbells just above your shoulders.
Press one dumbbell to the ceiling while keeping the other in place.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other dumbbell.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Start with two dumbbells near your shoulders with a neutral grip.
Press one of the dumbbells toward the ceiling while keeping the other in position.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Overhead Press
instructions: Start with both dumbbells near your shoulders in a neutral grip.
Press the dumbbells toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't arch your back as you fatigue.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the dumbbells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Arnold Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing you and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is directly above your head.
As you extend your arm, rotate your palm to face away from your body.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Neutral Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing your body and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, press the dumbbell upwards so that it is directly above your shoulder.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing forward and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Elevated Pushup
cardText:
1
Start by placing two dumbbells on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
2
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the dumbbells, keeping your arms straight.
3
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
4
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
5
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cardText:
1
Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

name: Dumbbell Incline Skullover
instructions: Lay flat on an incline bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
instructions: Stand with both palms facing you.
Begin to press the dumbbells to the ceiling while rotating your palms.
When you reach elbow extension, your palms should be facing forward.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Arnold Press
instructions: Start by sitting on an incline bench and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing you and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is directly above your head.
As you extend your arm, rotate your palm to face away from your body.

name: Dumbbell Seated Y Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench , grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Press the dumbbells outward into a y shape.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Dip
cardText:
1
Use a dip belt to attach a dumbbell to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
2
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
3
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

name: Dumbbell Y Press
instructions: Stand tall, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Press the dumbbells outward into a y shape.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Lay sideways on an incline bench and press the elbow of the working arm into the bench.
Use your free arm to pull your upper body into the bench.
Break at the elbow until your elbow is fully flexed, then extend your elbow until the dumbbell is pointed at the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Guillotine Press
instructions: Lay flat on a bench.
Push your elbows forward until your biceps touch your forearms. Then extend your elbows until back at the starting position.

name: Dumbbell High Incline Skullover
instructions: Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells above chest.
Flex elbows first, then flex the shoulders until a stretch is felt in your triceps.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Incline Skullcrusher
instructions: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbells above chest with palms facing in.
Bend elbows to lower dumbbells toward forehead under control.
Extend arms fully, squeezing triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Neutral High Incline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells with neutral grip at shoulders.
2
Press dumbbells upward until arms extend without locking elbows.
3
Lower slowly to shoulder level and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Skullcrusher
instructions: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbell above chest with palmsfacing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell toward forehead under control.
Extend arm fully, squeezing tricep at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Push Press
instructions: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip slightly at knees, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead.
Lock out arm briefly, then lower dumbbell under control.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit tall holding dumbbell overhead with one hand, arm fully extended.
Lower dumbbell behind head by bending elbow slowly.
Extend arm back up, squeezing triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on flat bench holding one dumbbell above shoulder, palm facing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell beside head without moving upper arm.
Extend arm fully, contracting triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Larsen Press
cardText:
1
Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding dumbbells above chest.
2
Lower dumbbells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Larsen Press
cardText:
1
Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one dumbbell above chest.
2
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press
instructions: Lie on bench holding dumbbell above upper chest with palm facing in.
Lower dumbbell toward neck or upper chest by bending elbow forward.
Extend arm fully, squeezing triceps at the top while keeping shoulder stable.
